exposure.needed: whether the operator filters cert-manager log output by text matching (e.g. grep) on the log lines whose format changed

consequence.statement: Some cert-manager log lines have changed format because of added structured logging information, so log filters based on grep or similar tools may stop matching.
consequence.remediation: Review any text-based log filtering against the new log line format, and prefer filtering on structured fields.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds more structured logging information to certain log lines, so some log lines have a different format; log filtering with grep or similar tools may no longer match.

checks.detail: protocol-behavior behavior-changed is not render-verifiable (runtime-only or no rendered shape)
